# Phoenix

![Phoenix](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/phoenix.png)

Each Tails stores anger (max 5). Heads: 3 points +2 per anger.

- **Rarity:** Epic
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 3 points

## Tails
Quota +2

- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
